task: U11 JAR v5 = U11d + cluster-5 dedup: AppContentProviders skips any provider stock already instantiated (ActivityThread.mLocalProvidersByName) before re-instantiating. Prevents double onCreate; enriches the probe.
supersedes: u11d 84c8da6b (phone+ssl+content); u11e is the current single U11 JAR version. (cluster 4 keystore reassigned to cc-wiki; merges in later.)

class_delta_vs_u10.note: 196 classes (+10); same set as u11d, AppContentProviders body changed (dedup).

cluster5_dedup: Before instantiating a provider, AppContentProviders looks it up by ComponentName(packageName,name) in ActivityThread.mLocalProvidersByName; if stock already instantiated it -> log '[B8-PROV-INSTALL] <authority> already instantiated by stock; skipped' and skip. Final log: 'installed N/total app providers (M already instantiated by stock)'. On the first board run this M splits the root cause: M>0 means stock's installProvider succeeded (gap is publish/registry); M=0 means stock never instantiated (gap is instantiation/install step).
